title: Duel Decks: Mind vs. Might: card flavor text

entities.name: Lady Azami
entities.description: A speaker who warns that knowing all parts of a name leads to a fate only the kami know.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits invoked by Lady Azami as the only ones who know what becomes of one who knows all of a name.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A faction of mages, including chronarchs, whose mages always answer that more power is required.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Enemies that some relic hunters have given up exploring to go and fight.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: A place whose blessing is a spectacular sight, though the best view comes at a high cost.

entities.name: Mirtiin
entities.description: Home of the eleven minotaur clans, some of them expert crafters and learned philosophers.

entities.name: Rorica
entities.description: A woman who broke with her order over the creation of the wolfir and led a crusade against them.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Created beings called "reformed werewolves," against whom Rorica led a crusade.

entities.name: Calydd
entities.description: A kithkin farmer who speaks of the cloudcrown trees.

entities.name: Cloverdell
entities.description: A place named by Calydd as somewhere a swatted hawk or faerie might be sent flying.

entities.name: Talara
entities.description: A safewright who protects a delicate woodland waterfall. She has vowed to send warriors to slay any who disturb it.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A faction regarded by some as savage simpletons, though their shamans wield subtle power.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: A speaker who foretells that the city will perish as the Gruul cheer.

entities.name: Boar-god
entities.description: A god who, Nikya says, will crush the city's last bricks into dust.

events.summary: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica breaks with her order and leads a crusade against them.
events.quote: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

events.summary: Talara vows to send wave after wave of warriors against anyone who would disturb the waterfall she protects.
events.quote: She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

relations.quote: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."
